name: negotiateProximityRetailDeal
description: Negotiates a price for a promoted item at a nearby store. Call it when the proximity service returns a campaign within the match radius (50 m by default). The tool runs up to five offer rounds against POST /api/agent/bargain and never offers above the shopper's budget.

campaignId.description: Campaign identifier from adContext.campaignId in the proximity response.

targetSKU.description: Stock keeping unit from adContext.sku in the proximity response.

initialOfferZAR.description: Opening offer in rand. The app uses 75% of the sticker price.

maxBudgetCeilingZAR.description: The most the shopper will pay. No offer may exceed it.
